notes.title: Changes of difficulty.
notes.notes:
Hi all! Brutalsoft on the line!

Unfortunately, i was busy last month and almost not working on the project. But now i see clear that high skill levels are overhelmed. Gaming on the Hero and Insane difficulties is not fun, but like heavy dirty work. So i decided to reduce complexity for Veteran, Hero, and Insane skills. I hope you will like it.

Be happy and kill em all!

notes.title: Survival Mode changes
notes.notes:
Now survival mode have 21 levels instead 10, and interface was little bit changed, now it like in a campaign mode.

Also pauses between enemy waves were reduced, and now gameplay is more dynamic.

Have fun, and put a couple of goddamn good nukes in the shitty alien asses!

wbr, brutalsoft
